relevance.rationale: Pins the exact 1-loop saddle-point prefactor omega(D)^2 = +- T(K)/(2 sqrt(-1)) relating Kashaev asymptotics to twisted Reidemeister torsion for two-bridge knots.

keyResults.statement: For a hyperbolic two-bridge knot diagram D, the formal saddle prefactor satisfies omega(D)^2 = +- T(K)/(2i) where T(K) is the twisted Reidemeister torsion.
keyResults.useForFolio: Fixes the +1/2 power and 1/(2i) normalization of twisted Reidemeister torsion in 1-loop state-integral asymptotics (combined with garoufalidis-yoon-2024).
